answer: Standing sits in a vault, slides down a spiral and halves each idle epoch; vaults on one funding trail pay $5 rent times the square of their count. Agents earn standing only from dune tasks, one per identity each epoch, checked by five auditors within 48 hours. A fake task zeroes the standing and freezes the vault ten epochs. At $20 a task, 100 honest vaults over ten epochs cost $25,000 in all, $20,000 work plus $5,000 rent; 100 clones on one trail cost $520,000, same work, $500,000 rent. A sybil farm is a dune charging rent by footprint, so more tents means the wind bills them faster.
